title: [MTR] Schwerer Gustav Railgun
description: Adds the Schwerer Gustav Railgun built by Krupp in 1937
body:
The Schwerer Gustav ("Heavy Gustav") was a German 80-centimetre railway gun, holding the record as the heaviest mobile artillery piece and largest-caliber rifled weapon ever used in combat. Built by Krupp in the late 1930s, it weighed nearly 1,350 tonnes and fired massive 7-tonne shells up to 47 kilometres.This resource pack adds it to MTR. 

The model is created by Skywalker_6517 (Skyworks Heavy Industries)
It features 2 types:
- Schwerer Gustav 
- Schwerer Gustav Raised
